notablePrerequisites: You control a noncreature permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
description:
Activate a noncreature permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting the mana-producing permanent.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of the permanent.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
